summary: TurnEngine.castSkill calls endActionStatuses(ch) (and removes Enchanted) BEFORE the spell body, so the caster's own Submerged/Blessed/Enchanted is gone when native Count* steps run. troop:6692 Mervorax spell 8038 (native 0:CountSpecificStatusEffect@AllAllies 300 submerged ; 2:CreateGems 6 Blue UseCounterForAmount) does not count a Submerged caster. R004 says Submerged/Blessed end after the holder acts (community t/80861 'vanish after spell cast'). Fix idea: snapshot the removed statuses in castTracking and let allyStatusCount/selfStatus conditions see them (or remove after the body while still letting self re-application survive). Re-check other self-including counters of submerged/blessed/enchanted (batch-07 7x, batch-10 8881?, batch-14). Same for troop:6933 Ishtara 8411 (CountSpecificStatusEffect@AllAllies blessed -> Yellow count; Blessed caster not counted) and troop:7325 Tuzi 8937 (enchanted allies -> Yellow count; Enchanted caster not counted, R002: Enchanted removed after the holder casts).
